auditor_patel: Hi team — auditor here. Need evidence for an RBAC change on 2026-02-15 22:07:00Z in inference-prod (org:redwood-main) tied to SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9. Request: RBAC change row (before/after), KMS CloudTrail slice +/-5m, Okta session/MFA events for principals, CSV+raw JSON, checksums, and a manifest.
nora: Got it. Confirm service= inference-prod (alias prod-inference). We’ll pull from read replicas.
josh: I'll pull rbac_changes rows. SQL: SELECT id, principal_id, change_type, changed_by, created_at, payload_before, payload_after FROM rbac_changes WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-02-15T22:00:00Z' AND '2026-02-15T22:15:00Z'; Output CSV + JSON.
lina: I'll extract KMS events for alias/redwood-kms-prod from CloudTrail for 22:02-22:12 UTC. Will include eventName, eventTime, userIdentity.principalId, errorCode if any.
infra-bot: Note: queries run against auth-read.eu-west-1 and ct-s3 eu-west-1. Read-only, no locks.
evidence-bot: job queued: exp-7721 by josh. ETA ~2m.
josh: RBAC export uploaded: s3://redwood-audit-exports/6812345678/rbac_20260215.csv (sha256: 9c1185a5...) and rbac_20260215.json (sha256: 2c624232...).
lina: KMS slice uploaded: s3://redwood-audit-exports/6812345678/kms_20260215.json (sha256: 3a7bd3e2...). Normalized CSV kms_events_20260215.csv (sha256: 6d7fce9f...). Found one failed Decrypt at 2026-02-15T22:08:14Z for principal svc-etl error=AccessDenied — flagged.
josh: RBAC change record shows user nora elevated principal svc-deploy from deployer -> infra-admin at 22:07:09Z (ticket INC-9901). No RBAC entry for svc-etl in that window.
auditor_patel: Please add svc-etl as an exception in control mapping with owner data-team and ticket #9902 and include remediation steps. Also include retention statement and source hosts in README.
nora: Added control_map_CC6_A9.csv with exception row (svc-etl -> data-team -> ticket 9902 -> remediation: validate encrypt-context, rotate relevant key if needed). Retention note: logs hot 1yr, cold archive 5yrs. Source: auth-read.eu-west-1, cloudtrail S3 eu-west-1, okta tenant redwood-eu.
evidence-bot: Bundle created: s3://redwood-audit-exports/6812345678/evidence_bundle_v1.tar.gz (sha256: e2fc714c47...). Presign: https://presign.redwood-internal/s/6812345678/evidence_bundle_v1.tar.gz (expires 72h).
auditor_patel: One more: can you include the exact playbook/commands used for exports in README so intake can reproduce?
josh: Added playbook excerpt to README: psql copy query for rbac, awsctl cloudtrail query for KMS, okta logs API curl.
auditor_patel: Thank you — I'll ingest and follow up if intake flags anomalies. Leaving thread open 48h. :thumbsup:
nora: Thanks team.
